data.standardized_narrative: Unable to locate an unambiguous gross prioryear reserve movement in the available images. The report images contain a claims development table and insurance liabilities notes, but the numeric cells were not reliably legible to extract a definitive gross prior year movement or opening gross claims outstanding. Gross written premium is visible.
data.data_quality_notes: Source images were low-resolution/rotated and OCR failed for many numeric tables. I could not reliably read the 'Claims outstanding' (gross) closing/prior-year balance or the explicit 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column. A gross claims development table appears on page 37 of the PDF, but numeric cells were not legible enough to compute prior year development or extract per-LOB movements. I have therefore returned null for opening reserves and prior-year development rather than risk incorrect amounts. Gross written premium (2372.2) was readable but should be cross-checked against the original PDF.
